bear_case: The BUY verdict's dependency on broad Asia strength obscures semiconductor-specific structural deterioration: SK Hynix declined -3.38% to ₩2,343,000 on the same July 6 session that KOSPI gained +5.76% — the most pronounced intra-market divergence of this cycle, confirming that memory/HBM4 weakness is decoupled from the broader Asian equity recovery. IBIT recorded its 11th consecutive outflow day on July 3 while aggregate spot ETF flows were positive, structurally indicating institutional money is still retreating from BTC exposure even as retail-driven funds (FBTC, ARKB) absorb supply; a 12th consecutive IBIT outflow on July 6 would confirm Gate 3 is structurally failing, not just delayed by the holiday. The ISM Services PMI risk is asymmetric: the prior reading of 54.5 is above the 52-level threshold the market currently prices as 'Goldilocks'; a repeat print near 54 would force the market to price out the 60–65% September cut probability, compressing long-duration tech multiples at Nasdaq P/E ~28x. Fed Chair Warsh's June 17 'unambiguous commitment to price stability' language plus a hot ISM Services eliminates the rate-relief pillar entirely. Counter-argument: NVDA pre-market $197.14 + KOSPI +5.76% + VIX 15.81 represent the strongest pre-open framework in this 12-session period. If SPX closes above 7,460 AND NVDA holds above $195 on July 6, the bear case is invalidated. If SPX fails 7,460 by July 6 close, the call is wrong.
